assets.title: Clockwork fox
assets.selection_reason: Completed base scene with a separately recorded continuation.
assets.prompt:
The humanoid fox turns his head and shoulders toward the open book, lowering his gaze as his eyes scan naturally across the pages. His ears make small, attentive movements while he holds the book steadily. Around him, pendulums swing, exposed gears rotate, and warm lamplight glints across the intricate brass mechanisms filling the majestic moonlit loft library.
Suddenly, every analogue timepiece reaches midnight. Pendulum clocks, carriage clocks, pocket watches, escapements, and the enormous clock window erupt into a layered mechanical clatter: hammer-struck brass bells, winding gears, deep chimes, rattling mechanisms, and spring-driven ringing—no electronic sounds. The fox is sharply startled; his ears snap upright, his eyes widen, and his shoulders jerk as the book dips slightly without falling.
Preserve the fox’s appearance, costume, book, lighting, and surroundings. Use natural movement, realistic anatomy, cinematic depth of field, and subtle atmospheric dust. No cuts, new characters, digital displays, morphing, extra limbs, speech, music, or electronic alarms.

assets.title: Airship over the valley
assets.selection_reason: Completed scene with a different reference, subject and motion direction.
assets.prompt: The camera pulls back slowly while tracking slowly right, revealing more mountainous city without losing the airship as the focal subject. The ship travels left to right, steadily descending beneath drifting clouds that move gently across distant peaks. Small flames appear along the gondola and lower envelope, then spread rapidly through the rigging and hull until fire engulfs nearly the entire craft. Thick smoke trails behind and glowing embers fall into the valley. Maintaining forward momentum, the airship crashes into the ornate domed structure on the right. The impact crushes the pavilion, buckles columns, shatters the roof, and sends masonry and brass fragments collapsing inward beneath burning wreckage. Use convincing physics, layered smoke, heat distortion, cascading debris, and atmospheric depth. Preserve the vintage engraved painterly style, sepia palette, mountain layout, airship design, and architectural detail. No unrealistic explosions.
